name: High School Problems
overview: High school challenges require trusting the Lord wholeheartedly rather than relying on personal understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 encourages. Choosing wise companions is crucial because walking with the wise leads to wisdom, while associating with fools results in harm (Proverbs 13:20). Believers are called to resist conformity to worldly patterns and instead be transformed by renewing their minds to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). By shining their light through good works and speaking words that build up others, students can glorify God and minister grace in their daily interactions (Matthew 5:16; Ephesians 4:29). God's plans for His people are filled with hope and peace, assuring students of a purposeful future amid their struggles (Jeremiah 29:11).
